prompt: Who was the Mayor of Quincy, Massachusetts when the Quincy Medical Center opened and who was the Mayor when it closed?
answer: Quincy Medical Center **reopened under that name in late 1999 while James A. Sheets was mayor** of Quincy. It **closed in December 2014 while Thomas P. Koch was mayor**.
